findings.fix: Create `TauCeti/Algebra/AlgebraicGroup/SpecialLinear/Scheme.lean` holding the named `groupScheme`/`groupSchemeι`/`groupSchemeιGeneralLinear` block, the closed-immersion and finite-type instances, and the `SchemePoints` section; leave the Hopf ideal, quotient Hopf algebra, and algebra-valued points in Basic.lean, and drop the `GeneralLinear.Scheme` import from it. findings.issue: The PR turns SL's thin kernel-spectrum abbrevs into a full named scheme layer inside Basic.lean: `groupScheme`, `groupScheme_def`, `groupScheme_X_left`, `groupSchemeι`, `groupSchemeιGeneralLinear`, both closed-immersion instances, and a new `### Scheme-valued points` section (`groupSchemePointMulEquiv`, `schemePointsMulEquiv`). Both sibling group directories keep exactly this material in a separate `Scheme.lean` (`AdditiveGroup/Scheme.lean`, `GeneralLinear/Scheme.lean`), and the new content is what forces `public import TauCeti.Algebra.AlgebraicGroup.GeneralLinear.Scheme` onto Basic.lean, so every consumer of the SL coordinate algebra and algebra-valued points now depends on GL's whole scheme presentation.

summary: The new root-subgroup file is correctly placed in SpecialLinear/ and its imports are used, but two pieces of new material live above their natural level: a pure group-theory transport lemma sits in the Hopf-scheme-points file, and the special-linear scheme/scheme-points interface is appended to Basic.lean instead of a SpecialLinear/Scheme.lean matching the sibling directories.
